Before enabling commands, require the matching server acknowledgment on a fresh, successful, validated GET bound to the current API origin, actor/session, selected company and generation. An error response never establishes readiness.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Code, legalName or tradeName contains search; Unicode trim + NFC, Turkish CI/AS.

parameters.name: addressCity
parameters.description: Exact Turkish CI/AS city match on one account-owned address row; Unicode trim + NFC.

parameters.name: addressDistrict
parameters.description: Exact Turkish CI/AS district match on the same address row as the other address filters; Unicode trim + NFC.

parameters.name: addressType
parameters.description: Optional address purpose. No primary-address priority is inferred.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Optional Party kind.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Repeatable Party role filter; one visible account must satisfy roleMatch.

parameters.name: roleMatch
parameters.description: Role matching mode; default any.

parameters.name: partyState
parameters.description: Global Party state; default active.

parameters.name: accountState
parameters.description: Visible company-account state; default all.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Keyset sort; default code.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Sort direction; default asc.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size; default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque authenticated cursor bound to actor, session, scope and normalized query.

parameters.name: includeCount
parameters.description: Return exact filtered authorized distinct Party count; default false.

expectedVersion.description: Required lossless positive Int64 decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807. JSON numbers are rejected.

AssignCounterpartyCustomerGroup.description: Assigns the active company's account a group of the SAME company, or clears it with an explicit null (customerGroupId must be present). expectedVersion is the ACCOUNT version as canonical decimal TEXT. Another company's or an unknown group is 422 customer_group_not_found; a passive group is never newly assigned (409 customer_group_inactive).

expectedVersion.description: Required lossless positive Int64 decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807. JSON numbers are rejected.

CounterpartyAccountEDocumentView.description: The account's customer VKN-shared e-belge profile (SAT-D119): a check or scenario set in one company is seen on the same-VKN customer in the others; the checker is shown only inside the company the check was recorded in (statusCheckedInActiveCompany, statusCheckedByDisplayName). taxIdentityNumberPresent is false when the party has no VKN (then status Unknown, scenario Unresolved, profileToken null). version + profileToken are the command fence ("0" = no profile yet). After a VKN change the card shows the NEW VKN's profile; the old one stays as it is. effectiveScenario is the override if present and listed, else the Settings default, else Unresolved; the default starts empty, so Unresolved is the normal start. evaluatedOn is the Europe/Istanbul business day the Settings keys were read for.

CounterpartyAddressChange.description: An upsert of a new UUID requires purpose (billing/delivery/operational), countryCode (two ASCII letters, stored uppercase), and line1. Existing fields may be omitted. No official/global address is changed. Country validation is syntactic, not an official country registry check. deactivate/reactivate requires an existing child and no value fields.

CounterpartyContactChange.description: New contacts require displayName and purpose. Channels are explicit operations; missing channels are retained. A contact never creates an Identity user or grants permissions.

CounterpartyContactChannelChange.description: New channel requires kind (phone/email) and value. Kind is immutable for a child UUID. Phone value maximum 32; email maximum 254. Extension maximum 10, phone only. deactivate/reactivate requires an existing child and no value fields.

CounterpartyContactInformationChanges.description: Omitted fields retain their values. Null/trim-empty clears optional text. Collections are explicit child operations, not replacement lists. Null collections are invalid. An omitted child is never deleted or deactivated. Phone prefixes, punctuation and leading zeroes are preserved. Email format is not deliverability verification; website permits http/https without credentials.

CreateCounterpartyCustomerGroup.description: Creates one customer group of the active company with a caller-chosen UUID, so an unanswered create is retried with the same Idempotency-Key and id. The name is trimmed (NFC), 1..100 characters, unique in the company among active and passive groups. Nothing is seeded.

remnantClassification.description: Optional. Only with outputClass UsableRemnant: the label classification the operator chose, exactly Standard or SecondQuality. Absent or null opens a SecondQuality label. The label always carries the separate UsableRemnant production status.

expectedVersion.description: Required lossless positive Int64 decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807. JSON numbers are rejected.

ManufacturingInputIssueConflictProblemCo.description: The input issue's 409 problem: the shared coded problem with the same codes. stockShortfall is optional. It is present only on a fresh inventory_manufacturing_physical_stock_insufficient refusal that Inventory attributed to this issue, and absent on every other code, on a replayed or stored answer and from older servers. No problem response establishes success or current authority.

ManufacturingPlanAllocationConflictProbl.description: The approval/reapproval 409 problem, with unchanged stable codes. planAllocationShortfall is optional and appears only for a fresh Inventory insufficient-free-stock refusal attributed to the authorized company and plan, after the attempted write was rolled back. It is absent from stored answers and replays; older servers may omit it.

ManufacturingPlanAllocationShortfallV1.description: Inventory's verified single-position refusal-time measurements, in canonical kilogram text. availableKg and missingKg are computed by Inventory; clients must not recompute them. This optional snapshot grants no authority and is not a current availability promise.

ManufacturingStockShortfallViewV1.description: The input issue Inventory refused because it would take physical stock below zero (SAT-D318). movementKind is Inventory's movement kind name; sourceKind, sourceId and sourceLineId name the order and its issue; labelId and productId name the parent label and its product; locationId is the stored location of the label's stock, null when the label holds none. requestedKg is the issue's lossless invariant kilogram text. availableKg is, in the same text form, the usable kilograms the issue could have taken there: the free physical kilograms less other demands' active reservations, never negative and always less than requestedKg. Reserved kilograms are not part of this view. It records nothing: the refusal is not stored.

OptionalOfGuid.description: Omitted: unchanged. Null: clear the optional reference. A supplied UUID must be nonempty.

OptionalOfIReadOnlyDictionaryOfstringAnd.description: Optional JSON value, not an Optional wrapper. Omission leaves state unchanged; explicit null is rejected.

OptionalOfProductReferenceChanges.description: Optional JSON value, not an Optional wrapper. Omission leaves state unchanged; explicit null is rejected.

OptionalOfProductRoleInputs.description: Optional JSON value, not an Optional wrapper. Omission leaves state unchanged; explicit null is rejected.

OptionalOfProductUnitChanges.description: Optional JSON value, not an Optional wrapper. Omission leaves state unchanged; explicit null is rejected.

OptionalOfstring.description: Omission leaves the value unchanged; explicit null is distinct and is validated per field.

PartyRole.description: Optional legacy trade classification. Zero means no specified classification; values 1 through 15 retain their stored flags. This value does not grant user permissions or restrict buying and selling.

name.description: Omission leaves the value unchanged; explicit null is distinct and is validated per field.

versionBefore.description: Lossless positive Int64 decimal string; null only for DraftCreate.

ProductRuntimeProblemContract.description: Actual Product problem body. Type/title/status are present; code/detail/correlationId/errors and lossless string version fields are conditional. A handler 403 can omit code. No problem response establishes success or current authority.

RecordCounterpartyEDocumentStatus.description: Records the e-belge status a user checked for the customer's VKN-shared profile (SAT-D102 / SAT-D119). A known status (EInvoice / EArchive) stamps the server time, the caller and the active company as the check, even when the value is unchanged; Unknown resets the status and its check. The fence is the pair the read returned: expectedVersion (the shared PROFILE version as canonical decimal TEXT, "0" = no profile yet; the first record creates it) and expectedProfileToken (which profile the read showed). Another profile than the one read — e.g. after the party's VKN changed — is 409 version_conflict. A party with no VKN/TCKN is 422 e_document_tax_identity_required; a passive account of the active company is 422 e_document_account_inactive. No external (GİB) call.

SetCounterpartyEInvoiceScenarioOverride.description: Sets the customer's e-Fatura scenario override (VKN-shared) to a code of the writing company's Settings scenario list in force today, or clears it with an explicit null (scenarioCode must be present). Fenced on expectedVersion (the shared PROFILE version, "0" creates) and expectedProfileToken as the status command. Settings without a list is 422 einvoice_scenario_code_list_missing; a code the list does not carry is 422 einvoice_scenario_not_listed; Settings that cannot be read is 503 service_unavailable (nothing stored); a party with no VKN is 422 e_document_tax_identity_required; a passive account is 422 e_document_account_inactive. Re-sending the current code is a no-op.

UpdateCounterpartyContactInformation.description: Updates only the selected company account. expectedVersion is its logical Version as canonical decimal TEXT (1..9223372036854775807), never SQL rowversion bytes or a JSON number. Missing fields are unchanged; explicit null clears optional text. A 409 version_conflict requires a fresh GET; the error does not echo numeric versions.
